hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
Flare and tanks sited downwind; hot work controls; static bonding on tanks and lines.
Monitors and wind indicators at the flowback spread; escape sets staged.

name: Test separator
function: The vessel downstream of the chokes that separates gas, oil, and water so each can be metered, giving the first measured production of the well.

tabs.overview: A horizontal three-phase vessel with an inlet diverter, a weir between oil and water, level controls, and a gas outlet with a back-pressure valve; each outlet has a meter. Retention time sets the separation quality; slugs from the well upset levels.
tabs.engineering: Working pressure classes such as 1,440 psi; relief valve sized for a blocked gas outlet; meters per phase.
tabs.connections: Choke manifold in; gas to the flare or sales; oil and water to tanks.
tabs.safety: Flammable inventory; relief and flare path proven before flow; H2S possible.
tabs.evidence: Public flowback and well testing overview (S25), field practice (S9).
tabs.operations: Rates logged every shift or continuously; sample points for water cut and shrinkage.
tabs.failure_modes: Level control failures, carryover on slugs, foaming, meter fouling.
